name: Joyzyme Group Limited
summary: Joyzyme Group Limited, a medical device company, engages in the research, development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of in-vitro diagnostic (IVD) reagents in the People's Republic of China. It offers male and female fertility IVD, parasite antibody detection, and Epstein-Barr virus antibody detection reagents; and auxiliary reproductive supplies and equipment. The company sells its products directly to hospitals and medical institutions, as well as to distributors. Joyzyme Group Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
